note: Bare '* WAIT' heading: same as bare '* TODO' (org-element needs trailing text; org-entry-get and agenda treat it as a TODO state) (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)

Lowercase/mixed-case planning keywords are planning lines in orgfdb as in Org, but orgfdb files each timestamp under its own keyword; org--get-time-properties matches case-insensitively yet compares with case-sensitive equal, so Org files lowercase scheduled:/deadline: under :closed (Emacs bug, see parser-risks.org Intentional differences)
file+sys:/file+emacs: keep the full scheme as link_type; Org splits :type file plus :application (query-language.org resolver section) (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)
Bracket link with an unregistered scheme is typed by orgfdb; Org treats unregistered schemes as fuzzy (links.custom_protocols in config.org) (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)
Links inside property drawer values are stored with source_context property_drawer (schema.sql); Org does not parse objects in property values (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)
Numeric priority [#10] is stored as priority (schema.sql); org-element only reads a single character cookie (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)
org-element drops the literal word COMMENT from :raw-value even when no space or tab follows (COMMENT + NBSP is not a comment, commentedp is nil); orgfdb keeps it as title text
Bare '* TODO' is a TODO state in orgfdb and in Org's outline/agenda regexps (org-entry-get); org-element requires trailing text (parser-risks.org, Intentional differences)
